g.text: UCOPE: two independent continuous training pairs
All three checkpoints were fixed before each run; none was selected for reporting. Error bars are +/- 1 evaluation SE conditional on each fitted pair.
Each row is one independent training instance. Its checkpoints and 64 evaluation worlds are not extra training replicates; no population interval is shown.
